requirements.text: A requirement with no evidence entry → ⚠️ open, still listed. Status in `evidence.json` from the agent is ignored.
A passing named test → ✅; a failing one → ❌; an unknown runner → ⚠️ open.
A command proof matching exit code and stdout regex → ✅; a mismatch → ❌. It runs with `shell: false`, with no pipes.
`(mocked?)` is flagged for an undeclared `jest.mock`. The `frozen before impl`, `new test`, `pre-existing` and `mutation-verified` labels are each derived correctly from fixture git history.
A local `test-results/` artifact path → ⚠️ open, "not reachable".
No CI on the PR head → the ⛔ line, plus an Open item.
`requirements.json` edited after its first commit → the drift warning.
The repo PR template is preserved: fixture template sections all appear in the output in order, and Evidence is inserted or filled.
Windows CRLF inputs parse correctly (same class as the 0.4.1 bug).

**Parity guard:** `build.md`, `ship.md` and `forge-auto.js` all reference `forge-evidence.mjs`. Mutation-verify it: remove the reference from one file, watch the test fail, restore, and record it in an `@mutation-verified` block.
Extend `agents-bundled.test.mjs`-style checks so the README lists `forge-evidence.mjs` among the shipped helpers.
`freeze` writes `.a5c/forge/requirements.json` from an acceptance spec (ids verbatim) or the task prompt's list, refuses to overwrite without --force, and tags PLAN additions `origin: "plan"`.
`build.md` PHASE A–D, `ship.md` and `forge-auto.js` run the freeze, the evidence task (pinned to the working branch) and the PR insertion; a branch mismatch forces every row to open.
`forge-summary.mjs` prints `Evidence: n✅ n❌ n⚠️ n⏭` from `evidence.result.json`.
`help.md`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` (0.6.0) document the evidence section, the strength labels and the declare-location / script-computes-status rule.
